ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the recent charges and investigations into Medicaid fraud schemes in Minnesota, and explore the root causes of these schemes.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud schemes in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent future occurrences?
ideas.insight: The recent charges and investigations into Medicaid fraud schemes in Minnesota suggest a larger problem with the state's healthcare system. This story would investigate the root causes of these schemes and explore potential solutions.

ideas.title: Child Food Program Schemes: A National Problem?
ideas.description: Investigate the recent conviction and sentencing of a Minnesota fraudster for a child food program scheme, and explore whether similar schemes are occurring in other states.
questions: Are child food program schemes a national problem?
What can be done to prevent future schemes?
ideas.insight: The recent conviction and sentencing of a Minnesota fraudster for a child food program scheme highlights the need for increased oversight and monitoring of food assistance programs. This story would investigate whether similar schemes are occurring in other states and explore potential solutions.
